mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are 57 degrees and overcast at Harriet Park. We are in the First Quarter moon phase, and while the International Space Station is passing over, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Public works contractors will begin chip seal road treatments on September 23, affecting Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue between 9 AM and 3 PM. Additionally, the City Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various site plans and surveys for new developments.

There is a lot happening this weekend. Today, you can visit the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, listen to live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and support the Bike the Barns fundraiser. Upcoming events include yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and trivia on Tuesday at the Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding recent activity, on September 5, an officer discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several streets, noting it as a viral prank with no damage caused.
Culver's is open for you until 10:00 PM tonight. Although today's flavor is currently unknown, it is a great time to stop by for a quick bite.
